CONFIDENTIAL
No. 223/38.
Central f/37
23rd February 38.

Report on rooms occupied at the Cathay Hotel by Japanese Government Officials.

Det. Insp. A. Telfer

Sir,

I beg to report that the Japanese Ambassador, Mr. Itoh, who has been living at the Cathay Hotel, Nanking Road left Shanghai for North China on February 21st 1938 and, it has been ascertained that the rooms vacated by him have been reserved for Ambassador, Mr. Shiratori, who is expected to arrive from Japan on or about February 23rd 1938.

（批：Special Branch copy）

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Alexander Telfer
Detective Inspector.

（批：Si note 23/2 C. 32）
DC (J)
When protection will be required ?

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 23 FEB. 1938）

（批：Lt. C. (Sp Br.)）
Mr. Shiratori is expected to arrive here on Feb 24. Arrangements for protection will be made then.

FILE
（批：24/2）

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER S. M. POLICE）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL 24 FEB 1938）

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, FEBRUARY 21, 1938

Mme. Chiang Back
At Hankow

HONGKONG, Feb. 20.—After
a stay of five weeks, Madame
Chiang Kai-shek left here for
Hankow by aeroplane yester-
day morning. She was accom-
panied by Mr. W. H. Donald.
Madame Chiang's departure
was kept a strict secret, and
only a few intimate friends
saw her and her party off at
the aerodrome.—Reuter.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 21 FEB 1938 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

（批：D.C.S.B. / FILE / 268 / 21/2.）

《字林西报》，1938年2月21日，星期一

蒋夫人返回
在汉口

香港，2月20日电。——停留五周后，蒋介石夫人昨晨乘飞机离开此地前往汉口。W. H. Donald 先生陪同前往。蒋夫人的行程严格保密，仅有少数密友在机场为她及其随行人员送行。——路透社。

Subject Reference visit of Mr. Ito, Japanese Minister at large, to Japan.

Made by Inspector Brownrigg. Forwarded [Signature]

Sir;
    Having received information from Inspector Oikawa that
Mr. Ito the Japanese Minister at large, was leaving Shanghai on
the 20-1-38, the undersigned visited The Cathay Hotel and
interviewed Mr. Iwamura and verified the following information;-
Mr. Ito left Shanghai by air at 10 a.m. 20-1-38, for Japan and
expects to return in about one week's time. The police escort,
in view of above, has been withdrawn for the time being.

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS - 19.10.37.

SPECIAL JAPANESE
ENVOY HERE

To Explain Tokyo's Position
To Local Diplomats

Mr. Nobubumi Ito, Japanese envoy-
at-large to Shanghai, arrived here
yesterday morning aboard the Naga-
saki Maru.
The envoy, who formerly served as
Minister to Warsaw, will, it is report-
ed, keep in close contact with the
members of the foreign Diplomatic
Corps here in order to present to
foreign envoys Japan's side in her
dispute with China.
Also aboard the vessel was Mr.
Akiyoshi Tajiri, returning from
Tokyo to resume his duties as First
Secretary of the Japanese Embassy
and Chief of the Information Section.

C 29/10

Made by D.S. Larby Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

At 10 a.m., yesterday (October 18, 1937), Mr. Nobubumi
Ito, Japanese envoy-at-large, arrived in Shanghai on board
the Nagasaki Maru and subsequently proceeded to the Cathay
Hotel where he is now occupying room No. 542.

Questioned by D.S. Kamashita and the undersigned, Mr.
Shinobu Iwamura, secretary to Mr. Ito, stated that no
arrangements regarding Mr. Ito's movements while in Shanghai
had as yet been made. He expressed confidence that the
Municipal Police would be able to provide adequate protection
for Mr. Ito during the latter's stay in Shanghai. In this
connection, it was informally suggested that Mr. Ito be
supplied with a uniform police escort consisting of one
foreign and one Japanese police officer who would be able to
occupy the same motor car as that used by Mr. Ito, thus
obviating the necessity of the Municipal Police providing a
vehicle for the use of the escort.

The advisability of having a foreign officer in
plain clothes on duty in the Cathay Hotel was also discussed,
no definite conclusion however being reached on this point.

撰写人：D.S. Larby 转呈人：〔此处转录不清〕

昨日上午10时（1937年10月18日），日本特命全权公使伊藤述史先生乘“长崎丸”号轮抵达上海，随后前往华懋公寓（Cathay Hotel），现居于542号房间。

经警探长 Kamashita 及本人讯问，伊藤先生的秘书岩村信夫（Shinobu Iwamura）先生表示，关于伊藤先生在沪期间的行动安排，目前尚未制定。他表示相信，在伊藤先生逗留上海期间，工部局警务处能够提供充分的保护。就此事宜，非正式建议为伊藤先生配备一名由一名外籍巡捕和一名日本巡捕组成的统一制服警卫随从，他们将能够乘坐与伊藤先生相同的汽车，从而免除了工部局警务处为警卫随从提供车辆的必要。

会议还讨论了在华懋公寓部署一名便衣外籍警官执勤的适宜性，但在此问题上未达成明确结论。

SHANGHAI TIMES - 19.10.37.
7/6/002

Japanese
Diplomat
Arrives

Mr. Nobubumi Ito Has
Come On Special
Mission Here

Mr. Nobubumi Ito, Japanese
envoy-at-large to Shanghai, arrived
here yesterday morning aboard the
S.S. Nagasaki Maru.
The envoy, who formerly served
as Minister to Warsaw, will report-
edly keep in close contact with the
members of the foreign Diplomatic
Corps here in order to present to
foreign envoys Japan's side in her
dispute with China.
Also aboard the vessel was Mr.
Akiyoshi Tajiri returning from
Tokyo to resume his duties as First
Secretary of the Japanese Embassy
and Chief of the Information Sec-
tion.
Interviewed by the Shanghai
"United News," a Japanese daily,
Mr. Tajiri is reported to have said
that "a complete accord regarding
the current Sino-Japanese hostilities
exists among all sections of the
Japanese people."

《字林西报》 - 1937年10月19日。
7/6/002

日本
外交官
抵达

伊藤述史先生
奉特派使命
来沪

日本驻上海特命全权公使伊藤述史先生于昨晨乘“长崎丸”号轮抵沪。
据悉，这位曾任驻华沙公使的外交官，将与在沪外国外交团成员保持密切联系，以便向各国使节阐述日本在中日争端中的立场。
同船抵达的还有田尻秋义（Akiyoshi Tajiri）先生，他自东京返回，将复任日本大使馆一等秘书兼情报科科长之职。
据日文日报《上海联合新闻》采访报道，田尻先生称，“日本各界民众就当前的中日敌对状态已达成完全一致。”
